semantics.clock: All sequential logic samples on positive clk edges, as explicitly specified.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset takes priority at a positive edge, clears search history and start_shifting.
semantics.sequence: Consume one data bit at each positive edge with reset low; recognize contiguous 1101, retaining matching suffixes during unsuccessful searches.
semantics.output: After sampling the fourth bit of 1101, start_shifting is 1 and remains 1 until a positive edge with reset high.
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization is specified; behavior is checked after a sampled reset.
semantics.evidence: problem.txt: searches for sequence 1101; set start_shifting to 1 forever until reset; active high synchronous; positive edge.

numeric.state: Five FSM states; no arithmetic, rounding or overflow

verification.oracle: Independent four-bit rolling input history plus valid-bit count and sticky flag, derived from original sequence requirement
verification.sampling: Drive at falling edges, compare after rising-edge nonblocking updates and before next rising edge
verification.coverage: All 256 eight-bit streams with reset between streams; long runs of ones, partial matches, sticky persistence, reset during matches and after detection, reset pulse without rising edge
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch, bounded timeout, explicit PASS only upon completion

specification_ambiguities.evidence: Original problem specifies reset but no initial state
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Do not prescribe or test a value before first sampled reset; no RTL initial block
